BiblicalUsage: Atarah was the second wife of Jerahmeel, and the record names her as the mother of Onam. She appears once, in the genealogy of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name kept in the family record is no small thing, because it means a mother remembered by name among the sons of Judah.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
